review: local Codex self-review, not external approval

criterion_review.provenance: pass: six isolated address roots per incarnation, A/B/A2/forwarder plus exact trusted administrator; kernel-stamped actual IPC and delegated endpoint sender; forged payload and stale generations deny
criterion_review.sharing: pass: cross-owner and second-app default denial; explicit B read succeeds, write/wrong-resource fail; child attenuation and no child escalation
criterion_review.forwarding: pass: exact caller-issued single-use tickets plus both caller/service grants; weak caller, weak service, substitution and replay deny
criterion_review.liveness: pass: finite at-most-60-second session leases, grant/context/deadline/revision checks; queued grant and session expiry, epoch invalidation between preview and execution; no mutation on denial
criterion_review.scopes: pass: denied synthetic app installer/account requests; narrow explicit disk scope succeeds and account/process/diagnostic/service scopes deny
criterion_review.restart: pass: actual broker #UD twice; peer closure and surviving direct mappings; fresh process/session/epoch, empty-policy denial before trusted restore, old process/context/checkpoint replay denial and exact settlement

unsafe_review.kernel: single CPU IF-clear; existing common syscall and return validation; copied 40-byte liveness query returns only exact admitted tuple existence, never authority; no new assembly or user-selected privileged return state
unsafe_review.broker: bounded allocation-free CPL3 policy/provider, exact bootstrap administrator and read-only roster; request words explicitly encoded little endian, never native-layout casts; no document contents or credentials in diagnostics
unsafe_review.commit: mandatory original/service binding, session, role, epoch, expiry, revision and context checks form the use-time authorization boundary; an admitted operation may finish after subsequent caller death/elapsed expiry; policy changes serialize with actions; no authorization cache or deferred kernel continuation
unsafe_review.teardown: quiescent kernel root/stack; remove waits then registry/maps/queued refs before process memory; publish fresh roots after roster mapping; two exact settlements
unsafe_review.limits: broker/provider co-located; out-of-band fixture administrator is bounded by kernel binding lifetime rather than ordinary subject leases; trusted synthetic launch fixture, no credentials, durable RBAC, universal direct revocation, real privileged services, independent frozen SDK, live replacement or guest UI
